pages.title: Danmaku Fire
pages.text: A doll can fire danmaku with a Star Wand or an Iron Dagger. Once the order is given, one doll fires at the target and then hands the attack on to the next.

$(bold)Reach and aim$(br)Shots are led for their own flight time, so a target that keeps moving is still hit, and they carry up to 48 blocks.$(br)$(bold)One volley, the whole squad$(br)An attack order walks down your dolls one after another instead of firing them all at once, each doll taking a single shot before the next is sent.
